English: Whenever you catch a fish, the data for that fish is uploaded to a remote server, to make a usable auto-fishing feature possible.

English: Whenever you catch a fish, the data for that fish is uploaded to a remote server, to make a usable auto-fishing feature possible. No personal information about you or your character is collected, only data relevant to the caught fish. You can opt out again at any time.
Japanese: 自動釣り機能の実現のため、魚を釣り上げるたびに魚のデータが外部サーバーに送信されます。本人やキャラクターの個人情報は収集されず、釣れた魚に関するデータだけが送られます。いつでも同意を取り消せます。
